meta.source: Ministry of Commerce and Industry, TradeStat (DGCI&S customs data)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each month is printed final (F) in its own month's table and revised final (R) in the table a year later; principal-commodity quick estimates are provisional (P). Every value carries its flag in meta.revision.
meta.coverage: How much India sells, by weight or count: exports of each principal commodity in its own unit (tonnes, kilograms, numbers), every month since January 2017
meta.note: TradeStat FTSPCC principal-commodity tables, quantity view. Each line is in the unit printed beside it; lines in different units are never added. The year-earlier column of a table a year later (unflagged) replaces the provisional (P) print where it exists.
